head: ḥǧǧ (< Arab. ḥǧǧ (III) cf. Wehr 228: disputieren, argumentieren, streiten;)

senses.gloss: disputieren, streiten, einen Vorwand finden (gegen ʕal);

stems.sensesRaw: disputieren, streiten, einen Vorwand finden (gegen ʕal);

examples.turoyo: disa ḥəlle mḥaǧaǧle aʕla: “ḥur! hat frə́slax-li taḥt i=mizən ḥatta d-nəflo aʕli!”
examples.translation: He looked at [the scales] again and found a [new] pretext against her: “Look! You have made the bed for me under the scales that they may fall upon me!”
examples.raw: disa ḥəlle mḥaǧaǧle aʕla: “ḥur! hat frə́slax-li taḥt i=mizən ḥatta d-nəflo aʕli!” ʻHe looked at [the scales] again and found a [new] pretext against her: “Look! You have made the bed for me under the scales that they may fall upon me!” 497; 41/14;
